title: Committee of Supply debate on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs budget
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on Head N, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in which Mr Yip Hon Weng moved to reduce the total sum by $100 and Members questioned ministers on foreign policy.
why_it_matters: The record says foreign policy shapes Singapore's food security, energy resilience, jobs and safety abroad, and that supply-chain disruption affects jobs, cost of living and business confidence. It also records MFA consular assistance for Singaporeans overseas, including during emergencies.

key_points.point: Mr Yip Hon Weng moved that the total sum allocated for Head N of the Estimates be reduced by $100.
key_points.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
key_points.quote: That the total sum to be allocated for Head N of the Estimates be reduced by $100

key_points.point: The Chairman invited Mr Yip Hon Weng to withdraw his amendment.
key_points.speaker: The Chairman
key_points.quote: I would like to invite Mr Yip if he would like to withdraw his amendment.

key_points.point: Mr Yip Hon Weng withdrew his amendment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
key_points.quote: I seek leave to withdraw my amendment.

key_points.point: Ms Sim Ann said relations between Singapore and China are very good.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
key_points.quote: Relations between Singapore and China are very good.

key_points.point: Ms Sim Ann said Singaporeans should remain vigilant when encountering online material and verify it.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
key_points.quote: Singaporeans should remain vigilant when encountering such material.

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said the unrest in Mexico will not affect the timeline for opening an embassy in Mexico.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: it will not affect our timeline.

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said he would not change the timeline for establishing an embassy in Mexico.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: I would not change our timeline for establishing an embassy in Mexico

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said Singapore has nominated Ambassador Rena Lee for election later this year to the International Court of Justice.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: we have nominated her for the election which will be due later this year for a seat on the International Court of Justice

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said Mr Daren Tang has been nominated again for a second term at WIPO by an overwhelming margin.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: Mr Daren Tang, who is leading World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), has been nominated again for a second term by an overwhelming margin.

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said he did not have the specific number of Singaporeans at the ASEAN Secretariat and suggested filing a Parliamentary Question.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: Maybe the Member can file a Parliamentary Question for that and I will provide it to Member later.

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said the main purpose of MFA engagement sessions is to provide safe and open candid platforms.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: the main purpose of these sessions is to provide safe and open candid platforms for these interactions to occur.

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said MFA needs to do more engagement sessions and engage a wider spectrum of the public.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: we need to do this and we need to do more of it

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said national athletes and artists are ambassadors for Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: our national athletes and artists and other creative personnel are actually ambassadors for Singapore.

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said Singaporeans should not let the team down or besmirch the reputation built by countless generations.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: do not let the team down and do not besmirch the reputation which countless generations have built

key_points.point: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan said this is a time to stand up, be confident and realistic and keep the flag flying high.
key_points.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
key_points.quote: This is a time to stand up on our two feet, be confident and realistic and keep the flag flying high.

key_points.point: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song asked whether Singapore has made any decision on the Board of Peace, including being an observer.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
key_points.quote: Has Singapore made any decisions in this regard, including being at least an observer.

key_points.point: Mr Ang Wei Neng asked whether unrest in Mexico will affect the timeline and resolve to open the resident embassy in Mexico.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
key_points.quote: whether the current unrest in Mexico will affect the timeline and resolve to open the resident embassy in Mexico?

key_points.point: Ms Eileen Chong Pei Shan asked what MFA's benchmarks are for whether engagement sessions build durable understanding.
key_points.speaker: Ms Eileen Chong Pei Shan
key_points.quote: what are MFA's benchmarks for whether such sessions are effective in building durable understanding

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong asked about MFA's position on plans to set up the embassy in Mexico and whether ongoing issues affect those plans.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: what is MFA's position on our plans to set up the embassy and will the ongoing issues affect our plans?

key_points.point: Mr Yip Hon Weng asked how Singapore will uphold a rules-based order consistently and credibly.
key_points.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
key_points.quote: how will Singapore uphold a rules-based order consistently and credibly?

key_points.point: Mr Vikram Nair said Singapore's foreign policy is anchored in the principles of sovereignty and the rule of law.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: Singapore's foreign policy is anchored in the principles of sovereignty and the rule of law.

key_points.point: Mr Liang Eng Hwa said Singapore does not choose sides but chooses principles.
key_points.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
key_points.quote: we do not choose sides, but we choose principles.

key_points.point: Ms Hazlina Abdul Halim asked how MFA will enhance public understanding of Singapore's foreign policy principles.
key_points.speaker: Ms Hazlina Abdul Halim
key_points.quote: How will MFA enhance efforts to strengthen public understanding of Singapore's foreign policy principles

key_points.point: Mr Foo Cexiang said it would be unwise to turn strategic decisions of this nature into public referendums.
key_points.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang
key_points.quote: it will be unwise to turn strategic decisions of such a nature into public referendums

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong asked why both the US and China accounts are important and how Singapore should work with both.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: Why are both accounts important to us and how should Singapore work with both?

key_points.point: Miss Rachel Ong asked how Singapore intends to use its ASEAN chairmanship to strengthen ASEAN cohesion and strategic autonomy.
key_points.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong
key_points.quote: how does Singapore intend to use its chairmanship to strengthen ASEAN cohesion and strategic autonomy

key_points.point: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi asked what Singapore's forward plan and contribution is to alleviating the Gaza crisis.
key_points.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
key_points.quote: what is Singapore's forward plan and contribution to alleviating this crisis and tragedy

key_points.point: Dr Hamid Razak proposed structured mid-career exchange or fellowship programmes between fellow middle powers.
key_points.speaker: Dr Hamid Razak
key_points.quote: whether Singapore can develop structured mid-career exchange or fellowship programmes between fellow middle powers.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Kenneth Goh suggested being more deliberate about using arts and sports events as part of diplomacy.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Kenneth Goh
key_points.quote: I was wondering if we can be more deliberate about using arts and sports events and hosting these events here as part of our strategy for diplomacy.

key_points.point: Ms Eileen Chong Pei Shan urged MFA to work with the Ministry of Education to embed geopolitical literacy throughout the curriculum from secondary school onward.
key_points.speaker: Ms Eileen Chong Pei Shan
key_points.quote: I urge MFA to work more deeply with the Ministry of Education (MOE) to embed geopolitical literacy throughout the curriculum from secondary school onward.
